title: Hybrid Cloud with On-Premises Integration
scenario: A healthcare company is migrating to AWS but must maintain connectivity to their on-premises data center for compliance reasons. They need a hybrid architecture with Direct Connect as the primary path and VPN as backup. Sensitive patient data must never traverse the public internet. Design the complete networking architecture.
requirements: Direct Connect with private VIF as primary connectivity
Site-to-Site VPN as backup with automatic failover
Transit Gateway connecting multiple VPCs to on-premises
VPC endpoints for AWS service access without internet
Network segmentation between production and development VPCs
AWS Network Firewall for traffic inspection between environments
